item.title: VPD responds to shootings at Fins and Feathers
item.description: VALDOSTA - The Valdosta Police Department recently responded to two shootings in the parking lot of Fins and Feathers at the mall. The post VPD responds to shootings at Fins and Feathers appeared first on Valdosta Today.
